applicability: Initial, replacement and update snapshots within one embedded SDK catalog lifetime.
conditions: A replacement snapshot supersedes queued older changes only for its own directory kind.
Only the newest live load generation may publish.
exclusions: Post-snapshot updates and updates from other directory kinds survive.
Catalog errors remain errors rather than successful empty catalogs.
A stopped bridge publishes no later SDK or DOM changes.

evidence: F4 actual-helper before/final reproduction and extended overlapping-directory regression; existing pagination/reconnect/teardown cases.
